Name: EasyFarming
Author: MountainDewBoi
Description:
This mod is used to plow a 9x9 area on your farm, plant crops of the seed you're holding in your hands, grow those crops, and harvest them all at once within a very short time. To do this, simply hold seeds in your hand and press [b]J[/b] on your keyboard. The best way is to create a new game and use the parsnip seeds you get in the intro, as shown in the video below!

[youtube]xZ6mGqEm73I[/youtube]

This is heavily inspired by the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/572]Point-And-Plant[/url] made by Nexus user [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/35568295]jwdred[/url], thanks! :)

[b]Disclamer[/b]:

Do not use this on existing save games!

I am not be responsible if this messes up your game in any way!

This might lag your game or PC.

Please do not use this mod, it's very boring if you do so for your real saves.

Manifest.Name: EasyFarming
Manifest.Description: Easily farm a ton of plants without even using up any of your seeds. Totally not made specifically for the Steam Summer Sale 2019 Grand Prix game. I specifically want to discourage you from using this mod. It's no fun.
